answer: Require each new identity to post a small stake that decays in a downward spiral as sibling identities draw from the same funding vertex: the Nth identity funded by one source holds 1/N of the weight. Real trust accrues only from completed, peer-verified work, and each epoch the tide of new emissions flows to established vertices, never to fresh ones. Sybil factories then face linear cost per fake identity against sublinear, shared reward, so scaling the attack loses money.
